import React from 'react' export default function About() { return (

Inventory Management System - MERN CRUD App

An Inventory Management System (IMS) is a software solution that helps businesses track, manage, and update their product data efficiently. In this project, we’ll build an IMS using the MERN stack — MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js — with full CRUD functionality (Create, Read, Update, Delete).

Key Features

✅ Add New Product Create new product entries with name, price, and barcode ✅ View Products Display all products in a clean and organized table. ✅ Update Product Edit product details dynamically. ✅ Delete Product Remove products you no longer want in inventory. ✅ Search/Filter Quickly find products from the inventory list.
